cancelReason.description: Present only on a CANCELLED wave.

404.description: The wave, route, partner or (for an attempt) the package on the route does not exist. Problem types `not-found`, `package-not-on-route`.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

409.description: Conflict with the aggregate's state or capacity. Problem types: `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update`, `route-over-capacity`, `route-not-started`, `already-delivered`, `attempt-already-recorded`, `package-not-inducted`, `package-already-routed`, `stop-key-mismatch`, `partner-inactive`, `partner-station-mismatch`, `route-incomplete`. ErrWaveFull (`wave-full`) and ErrInductionClosed (`induction-closed`) are raised only by policy-driven induction, which has no route.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left
